description:
Who would not like to read some of your favorite stories retold in a different way? Fairy Tale is an adaptation of four classic stories : The Little Mermaid, Cinderella, Rapunzel and Snow White. Ethnically different, but essentially the same, our princesses will live their adventures in different cultures and places.

**Official English:** [Webcomics](https://webcomicsapp.com/comic/New-Fairy-Tale/5bd9a06ad5626e0bf9586d79),[Webtoons](https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/new-fairy-tale/rapunzel-finale/viewer?title_no=21791&episode_no=151)
